description:
JupyterLab computational environment desktop application, based on Electron.


JupyterLab Desktop v4.6.3-1
Updates
- Update to bundled JupyterLab v4.6.3 in #1107
Bug & security fixes
- Fix file-system settings race and remove orphaned serialize-javascript resolution by @notluquis in #1075
- Snap on stable cannot launch: refresh electron-builder past the .tar.7z extraction bug by @notluquis in #1091
- Make blocked navigation the default for views nobody claimed by @notluquis in #1093
- Fix the Linux packages failing to launch, and verify each installer in CI by @notluquis in #1094
- Let server-initiated sign-in chains complete without leaving the app by @notluquis in #1087
- Refuse browser permissions to content that is not the Jupyter server and limit permissions grants by @notluquis in #1092
- Harden the news feed against malformed feeds and empty results by @notluquis in #1028
- Refresh @xmldom/xmldom to the patched 0.8.13 by @notluquis in #1080
Documentation improvements
- Correct the minimum supported OS versions by @notluquis in #1071
- Rename dev.md to CONTRIBUTING.md and document the test suite by @notluquis in #1121
- Drop warning on maintenance status by @krassowski in #1070
Maintenance
- Change release PR environment by @krassowski in #1067
- Drop the isDevMode comment about the check it replaced by @notluquis in #1111
- Add the pull request template, ported from jupyterlab by @notluquis in #1110
- Ask Electron whether the app is packaged instead of reading an undocumented internal by @notluquis in #1097
- Fix flaky signing of mac assets and update release docs by @krassowski in #1069
- Run the unit suite on macOS and Windows too by @notluquis in #1112
- Fix the macOS installers failing to sign, and the cross-architecture dmg that hung by @notluquis in #1127
Full Changelog: v4.6.2-1...v4.6.3-1
